correctness.rationale: The literal 106-character four-symbol witness was fetched from witness.txt at the assigned tree, and independently re-enumerated modular length-four windows. All 106 are nonpalindromic and occupy distinct reversal classes; 106 choose 2 = 5,565 unordered pairs checked. There are (4^4−4^2)/2=120 nonpalindromic reversal orbits and 14 unused. Hence M_4(4)≥106; this is existence, not optimality or any general alphabet statement.

General asymptotic sequence constructions and the 112 upper bound do not imply this witness. Best-of-knowledge priority is subject to other unindexed cycles.

value.rationale: A finite extremal combinatorial construction can be valuable when it materially tightens a natural fixed-parameter bound: 106 improves the documented 88 by 18 (about 20%) and reduces the remaining gap to the 112 upper bound from 24 to 6. The exact witness is reusable for reversal-avoiding cycles and bidirectional sequence design; a general proof of the optimum is not required.
